meta_desc: Keep WizCommerce and add spoken orders for accounts that still send scans. Buyers approve each line, so less needs reading. A WizCommerce alternative that adds.
text: Off an order that would have been phoned
Is the first order for most kitchens
What sends distributors looking for an alternative to WizCommerce

WizCommerce runs rep-led, online, EDI and marketplace sales in one AI platform, with a storefront, a CRM, payments and a real food and beverage feature set. None of that is the problem. The hunt for a WizCommerce competitor tends to start with the checking at your end, and that is a narrow thing to fix.
Something inferred still has to be checked

Their own description includes a final review step for your team before orders reach the ERP, which is the honest way to build it. It does mean the accuracy question stays with you: did it read that right, and did your team spot it if not.
A tool that reads handwritten sheets and voice notes stays busy because kitchens keep sending them. The pile only gets smaller when some of those kitchens start sending something else.
Pulling a suite out to fix one step
Store, CRM, payments, quoting and catalog imagery come as one product family. Taking all of it out because some kitchens still fax in handwriting would be a great deal of change for a small gain.
What a WizCommerce alternative can add without replacing it
Spoken into lines, not onto a note

A chef says what is short and the items appear from that account's guide, already against your codes and your prices. The buyer sees each line as it appears and fixes it before sending, so nobody at your end pieces the order together afterwards.
The person who placed it approves the list
Spoken in the cooler or the office, at any hour
20 to 30 minutes back against the same order by phone
Nobody writes up a reorder from an account on the app, so the reps get that time to sell
A short list built from what you sell them

Each account works from the items it actually buys, carrying your codes at the figure you hold for that customer. Orders arrive in your own items and codes, because each line is picked from that customer's guide.
Every line drawn from their guide
The catalog and the pricing stay yours to set
Edit a guide once and the next order already has it
Saved as they go if the cook gets pulled away
Delivered the way your office already takes it
The order leaves as an email carrying a PDF, Excel or Word file, or goes straight into your ERP over the API, over EDI, or into QuickBooks. No part of your stack has to move to make room for it.
Addressed to a named rep, or to the purchasing desk
On a direct feed nobody retypes it at your end
Its own number, with the date and time it was sent
Picking, billing and delivery carry on unchanged
Stock on view as the orders come through

VoiceOrder Solutions carries real-time inventory visibility tied to order activity, and the catalog updates as stock levels change. It is not the system of record for stock: whatever you run today keeps that role, and a demo shows how the levels connect.
Across the whole catalog, not just the quick movers
Fewer stockout surprises on a late, heavy order
Levels come out of the system you count with now
No counting and no buying happens on our side
Running WizCommerce and VoiceOrder Solutions together

Running both is a perfectly sensible outcome, because we are not a WizCommerce replacement. Our app moves one group of accounts off producing paperwork at all, and anything still arriving as a scan or a spreadsheet keeps being read. For many distributors that is what a WizCommerce alternative amounts to.
Accounts on the app send lines they have already checked, not a note to decode. The assistant that reads documents keeps every other channel it already handles.
Quotes, payments and the store stay put
None of that is on offer here and none of it is affected. We hand over a finished order and take no view on what the rest of your stack does with it.
Point it at the accounts that phone most
Buyers who already self-serve in the storefront can stay there. Begin with a handful of the kitchens that call the desk, and leave every other arrangement exactly where it is.
See what lands on the desk
Twenty minutes. A buyer speaks, the lines come up from their guide, and what reaches you is already in lines.
Three steps, and no IT project
You hand over the guides, we load them and set up each account, and the kitchens take it from there.
A spreadsheet is enough. Items and the price per account land in one admin screen, against the codes you already use.
Accounts are opened for you, and the kitchen downloads the app. Most will have sent something in before the day ends.
Approved by the buyer, numbered and timed, set out in a format your desk already takes.
WizCommerce with a voice step added.

This table shows your operation twice: the way it works now, and with spoken orders added for the accounts that need them. A WizCommerce alternative usually comes up over what has to be read and checked, and that is where adding voice changes things. The two products do not connect, and every WizCommerce detail is from their own site.
Orders spoken into an app, line by line
AI reads scans, spreadsheets and handwriting
Each line approved by the buyer before it sends
Rep app, branded storefront and CRM
Each account buys from its own list, at your prices
Is a WizCommerce alternative the only way to get spoken orders?

No. You can keep WizCommerce and bring us in for the accounts who prefer talking an order through to writing one. Everything their platform does now carries on. The difference is that some orders arrive already built as lines, so there is less for the assistant and your team to read.
Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than WizCommerce?

Not at what they are built for: reading a handwritten sheet, quoting an inquiry, running a store, customer records or payments. We do none of it. Where we are stronger is one step, an order the buyer builds and approves, so your team is not left decoding a message. That is a reason to run us next to their platform rather than instead of it.

They do: voice notes are on their own list of what the assistant reads, alongside scans and handwriting. So a WizCommerce alternative pitched on voice alone would be wrong. The difference is when the order takes shape. A note gets interpreted after the fact, while in our app the speaking builds the lines and the buyer approves them before anything is sent.
Is WizCommerce linked to VoiceOrder Solutions in any way?

No. There is nothing between them, and each company supports only its own product. Each sends its orders into your own system separately: theirs through their ERP connections, ours as email, EDI, API or QuickBooks. Neither one routes through the other.
Will storefront buyers need a second way to order?

Only if you choose to give them one. Our app is for any kitchen that still phones, emails a scan or sends a spreadsheet. Be clear on one limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no order number from us, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock. Only orders placed in the app do.
How fast could spoken orders be running?

Most distributors have the app live in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens manage a first order that day. Nothing in WizCommerce has to change, so the platform keeps running while your first few accounts start speaking orders.
How is pricing handled if we keep both?

We quote per distributor and publish nothing, and they quote their platform too. The one price list they publish is for their AI photo product, which has its own page and tiers. Keeping WizCommerce means the only new cost is our app, and a quote from us covers that.
Where do the WizCommerce details on this page come from?

The WizCommerce facts above were checked at wizcommerce.com, dated 10 October 2026: the product family, the assistant's own list of what it reads, the review step and their industry pages. We do not repeat their performance numbers, which are theirs to stand behind. Anything that has moved since is a mistake at our end.

hero.h1: Weighing A WizCommerce Alternative? Add Spoken Orders Too.
hero.lead: Get orders that come in as clean lines the buyer has already checked. VoiceOrder Solutions sits alongside WizCommerce: buyers say the lines into our app, straight off their own guide, and approve each line before it sends. Their AI keeps reading the scans and spreadsheets that still come in.

mainCta.h2: Give your review step less to do
mainCta.body: Twenty minutes, one spoken order, from the kitchen to your inbox.
